AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.

4. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.

5. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

10. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.

11. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.

12. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Propulsion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
